data.narrative:
Mission Zero Technologies is a Series A climate and energy company founded by Nicholas Chadwick, Shiladitya Ghosh, and Gaël Gobaille-Shaw. The target has raised £21.8M to date. The valuation assessment draws on a peer set of 9 companies in the Climate & Energy sector, comprising 1 public company (LNZA) and 8 private firms including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix.

The Stage-Progression method is the primary applicable valuation approach. Using total capital raised (£21.8M) as a Series A proxy and applying a typical 2.0x step-up multiplier to reflect progression toward Series B, this method implies a valuation of £44M. A Peer-Median approach was not viable due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within the narrow Climate & Energy peer set; only zero same-stage and zero adjacent-stage datapoints were available, falling below the minimum threshold of three required for statistical reliability.

The triangulated valuation range is £37M to £50M, with a median of £44M. This single-method conclusion carries material execution risk; validation would benefit from broader peer coverage or direct market signals (recent fundraising activity, term sheets). Key uncertainties include the company's underlying unit economics, capital intensity relative to Climate & Energy peers, and timeline to Series B.
